description.value: Study for an illustration. At center, two story house on the corner of a street with a palm tree in the front on the sidewalk. The roof of the house is pointed with a semi-circular window centered on the front. Three windows on the top floor of the building have shutters on either side, and ironwork along the bottom. Two windows with shutters are visible on the bottom floor, partially obscured by a picket fence. Extending to the right of the house, a portico with a half-railing around the top of the balcony.
